disabled_reason: Hashed styled-components class names will change across deploys. No in-stock signal on listing tiles. Selectors need a stability review.
notes: Verified via DOM inspection: 48 product tiles render as article[data-product-id='<id>'] elements, each with an h3 title, a price using stable-looking class .stm-price__root (shared design-system token), and a product link matching a[href*='/product/']. No pagination UI, 'load more' button, or product-count text was found - all 48 products appear to load on a single page (possibly limited to a fixed page size server-side rather than true 'all products', so max_pages/url_pattern left as none/null - worth re-checking if the real catalog under this brand has more than 48 SKUs). No explicit in-stock/out-of-stock text or badge was found on any of the 48 tiles inspected, so in_stock is left null; most CSS class names on this site are hashed styled-components tokens (e.g. 'sc-1twc5z9-1 iIZx') that will likely change between deploys - only data-product-id and the h3/a[href] structure should be considered durable.
